youtube.title: neon — new wave verses into old-school rave drops, 132 BPM
youtube.description:
Deep house and old-school rave: new wave verses opening into breakbeat drops at 132 BPM in A dorian, with an Oberheim DMX, a reese bass, a chopped amen break, acid bass, piano stabs and a hoover.

Upbeat for dancing, deep rather than sweet. A dorian gives the minor its raised sixth, the deep house colour rather than the sad one, and the harmony sits on seventh-chord vamps that hold instead of changes that resolve. The verses run on a DMX kit, a reese pumping the octave in a 3+3+2, and a wavetable hook that enters off the beat. The drops go to a 909 over breaks with the amen chopped underneath. The twist re-cuts the break every bar and glitches the lead, for the Aphex side of the house.

Written as text, mixed by measurement, rendered in the browser.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:14 Verse
0:40 Build
0:54 Drop
1:23 Twist
1:38 Break
1:52 Drop 2
2:21 Outro

Play and edit this song in your browser at jonborchardt.github.io/strudel-bench — press play, drag a slider, change a note, hear it immediately. Nothing to install. 

Every song here is a text file. This one is songs/neon.strudel in the repo, along with the harness that plays it:
https://github.com/jonborchardt/strudel-bench

strudel-bench is a live-coding harness where a song is a text file written in a high-level language: parts, sections, and twelve musical axes (density, brightness, weight, space, articulation and so on) that a phrase like "darker and more spacious" can move. Most of the code and the songs were written by coding agents working from a written spec, in the spirit of my blog, "always shippable, always improving":
https://jonborchardt.github.io/blog/

The video is not a screen recording. It is generated from the song itself: every hit in the music drives the animation, and the world it plays in is chosen from the song's own musical features.

Built on Strudel, the JavaScript port of TidalCycles: https://strudel.cc
Samples come from the public Strudel packs, each under its own license: https://strudel.cc/learn/samples/

prompt: an upbeat rave for dancing, new wave mixed with old school, for the rave visual; then deeper, heavier and more interesting without slower, sad or dark; with an Aphex Twin / Amon Tobin side

requests.ask: make a new song: upbeat, rave, new wave mixed with old school, works with the rave visual; she loves Aphex Twin and Amon Tobin; the first pass was bubblegum and meaningless: deeper, more interesting, heavier, not slower, sad or dark

changes.why: A:minor>A:dorian the raised sixth is the deep colour, not the sad one
pop changes>i7 IV7 vamps and IV7 VII in the break: sevenths that hold instead of resolving
square pluck>sawtooth reese, weight .65>.8, register .35>.25, in a 3+3+2 octave pump: heavier without slower
casio:1>wt_digital:0 hollow, the hook rewritten with off-beat entries and a leap to the fifth and the dorian sixth
brk amen chopped in 16 under the 909, re-cut every bar in the twist: the Amon Tobin side
acid square pluck, brightness wobble(.35,.8), weight .85, aggression .65: the acid line
handchimes>square hollow low counter-stab: the chimes were the bubblegum
the DMX owned the mix, the hook sat 13 dB under it (measure)
the hook to the foreground, -9.5 dB under the mix (measure)
the 909 was 1 dB under the mix (measure)
the hoover to the foreground, -8.9 dB (measure)
the piano stabs were 24 dB under (measure)
clap up with a compressor, crest 25 (measure)
the acid was over the mix alone (measure)
the glass lead was 30 dB under (measure)

requests.ask: verse is 2 measures too long; drop2 to outro too abrupt; better transition into the twist and a bit less chaos in it

changes.why: bars
sweep 2 and fx.riser 2 the filter closes under a riser into the twist
impact the twist opens on a hit
RECUT the triplet-stutter and backwards bars replaced by a straight bar and a late stutter; drums.variation .6>.4, melody.variation .7>.4, perc simpler
sweep 2 the filter closes over its last two bars
the hook carried over at level 1.2 with space ramp(.4,.8) and brightness ramp(.6,.3), farther each bar

requests.ask: verse to build needs a transition

changes.why: riser 2 a two-bar riser out of the verse
impact the 909 arrives on a hit
